rounds.rule: A row gets ok only from a current listing, its own site or recent reviews with nothing saying closed (docs/EATS.md). A row is taken out when a search could not find the place at all or the sources disagree; a place found but not freshly confirmed stays without ok.
rounds.scope: the 3 rows without ok; the rows already confirmed were not checked again
rounds.how: Google Maps opened in headless Chromium (2026-11-23), limited view without a reviews tab, so no review date could be read; a place with current hours and no closed notice counts as a current listing

kept_without_ok.name: Chimi Lhakhang Cafeteria
kept_without_ok.evidence: Google Maps: 'Chimi Lhakhang Organic Cafe', buffet restaurant, 4.4★, Sopsokha (GVC9+FX4), but with no hours ('Add hours'), and its name is only similar to the row's

kept_without_ok.name: Phuenzhi Diner
kept_without_ok.evidence: Google Maps could not find it ('Phuenzhi Diner, Khuruthang' and 'Phuenzhi Diner Punakha' listed other Punakha restaurants); a web search found a Trip.com page 'Puenzhi Diner', Khuruthang, Punakha 13001, with no date — the place exists in a listing but nothing current confirms it

kept_without_ok.name: Karma's Coffee
kept_without_ok.evidence: Google Maps could not find it (searches listed Good Karma Cafe, Karma's Dhaba on Phendey Lam and Karma's Diner); a web search found only a directory entry (vymaps, Phendey Lam) and 2011 blog posts — nothing current
